items.name: Handwraps of Force
items.description: While wearing these wraps, whenever you make an unarmed strike, you may push your target up to 2 spaces and yourself the same distance in the opposite direction. You may instead make an attack with no target, striking the air to propel yourself 4 spaces in any direction

items.name: Keycoin
items.description: Insert into a keyhole to magically unlock a door. On use, the coin teleports 1d88 miles away.

items.name: Additional Healing Potions
items.description:
**Lesser Healing Potion.** Action: Drink or administer to recover 1d4+2 HP.

**Omega Healing Potion.** Action: Drink or administer to recover 5d10+10 HP.
items.moreInfo:
A diluted version of a Healing Potion; which is effective for scratches, bruises, and other daily pains. Your typical apothecary can brew these easily, with the right ingredients.

Omega Healing Potions are believed to be--at least in part--the blood of the gods. They are rare and have many buyers, but some of the most common and most generous are always religious in nature.

items.name: Manglemaul
items.description:
1d6+STR bludgeoning damage. On hit: you
may Grapple a creature smaller than you
(escape DC 10).
items.moreInfo:
Action: You may swing a creature
Grappled this way at another creature within Reach,
damaging both of them and ending the Grapple.

items.name: Button of Protection
items.description: A small, unassuming button etched with a faintly glowing sigil. When sewn onto an outfit, as a reaction when you are attacked, you may pull the button off and throw it into the air. The button emits a sudden, dazzling flash of light and a high-pitched whistle. The attacker must make a WIL save or be distracted, causing the attack to miss you.
items.moreInfo:
After use, the button becomes inert. It can be sewn back onto a garment during a Safe Rest by an experienced seamstress or tailor with silver thread, which reactivates its power.

Core Rules v0.9

items.name: Rifle
items.description: 2-handed, Range 12, Load 2. 1d12+DEX Piercing damage, Costs 50 GP.

items.name: Additional Mana Potions
items.description:
**Lesser Mana Potion.** Action: Drink or administer to recover 1d4 mana.

**Omega Mana Potion.** Action: Drink or administer to recover 5d4+5 mana.
items.moreInfo:
A diluted Mana Potion, which may or may not work... the cheapness, ease of use, and sweet-sour taste make up for it; to the average hedge mage that is.

Omega Mana Potions are made only by the absolute most experienced alchemists and mages working together. They are considered to be just a step below the philosopher's stone in alchemy.

items.name: Gem of Escape
items.description: **_ACTION_**. Crush one in case of emergency to instantly teleport ALL who are bound to one to the location of the other gem.
items.moreInfo: These magical gems are always crafted in pairs and can have any number of willing creatures magically bound to them.

items.name: Your life, for mine
items.description: 1d6 + DEX piercing. (1/turn) Take 1 wound to make the die crit.
items.moreInfo: Used by the most wicked cheats.
